We were worried so we send him to a therapist and now he goes once a week. In our eyes he is still the same kid that before. We tried to think about things that he may have. 4. **Social perception** — Knowing you look polished can reduce anxiety about how others perceive you, allowing you to focus more on your tasks or interactions.
